note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: Gong
plugins.description: Finished calls, summaries, and transcripts. Granola covers the meetings it did not record.

plugins.name: Granola
plugins.description: Transcript source for meetings your recorder did not capture. Works alongside Gong or on its own.

plugins.name: Salesforce
plugins.description: Where next steps, stage, close date, and new contacts are proposed. Connect the one CRM you use.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Learns your voice from sent mail and saves follow-ups as drafts. Use Outlook instead on Microsoft 365.

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Matches a call to its meeting and attendees when the recorder's participant list is thin.

plugins.name: Slack
plugins.description: Deliver the post-call pack as a DM.

plugins.name: Notion
plugins.description: Keep post-call notes and the open promises where your team already looks.

plugins.name: Linear
plugins.description: Turn a commitment from a call into a ticket, drafted for you to approve.

plugins.name: Hex
plugins.description: Pull account numbers before a call when your team keeps them in a warehouse.
